name: Bansal Roofing Products Limited
about: Bansal Roofing Products Limited engages in the design, engineering, manufacturing, supply, and erection of pre-engineered steel buildings in India and internationally. The company offers roofing sheets and accessories, decking sheets, process-plant structures, roll-formed products and other customized fabricated-steel products, heavy steel structures, solar module mounting structures (MMS), industrial structural steel, crane-supporting structures, portal frames, multi-storey steel buildings, process plant structures, roofing and wall cladding systems, and other customized fabricated steel products. It serves customers across industrial, infrastructure, renewable energy, warehousing, logistics, commercial and institutional developments, as well as manufacturing, power, renewable energy, cement, oil and gas, metals, pharmaceuticals, automotive, engineering, warehousing, airports, and infrastructure industries. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Vadodara, India.
